text: According to the partner visa protocols, PIBA is definitely authorized to issue an entry visa to applicants who received a B2 visa as part of the process. This clause was recently changed exactly to protect people like you, who followed the rules and went by the book. If they refuse to give you an entry visa, please contact האגודה הישראלית לזוגות בינלאומיים aic.org.il and we will help support@aic.org.il
